# R26 clean recent upstream B4 control

Preregistered before model runs: isolate upstream HEAD observed f498f864fbc0472004ee1c3616c1188c68eb157f on2026-10-07 in a separate unmodified checkout. Keep original7fe and all frozen runs unchanged. Build Release/native/Ninja/Vulkan with GCC16.2.1; compile the identical replay helper outside upstream against that revision headers/libraries; record any necessary API adaptation as helper-only patch. No engine cherry-pick in this campaign.

Workloads: recorded244+128 and3107+128, exact token hashes from versioned inputs. Same ngl99/ncmoe18/t8/tb8/b512/ub512/FAon/Q8KV/fitOFF, mmap, c1024 short/c8192 long, metadata-only memory clear/default, no inherited GGML/RADV/VK flags/callback/profiler. Check actual defaults/placement/allocations and supported parameters before execution. Each process internal warmup+one raw correctness repetition. Four fresh B4 processes, order short/long/long/short. Every129/135 vocabulary vector must be finite/nonzero; pairwise bit equality required for repeatability. Compare originalB1 canonical short separately; current-vs-old logits differences are not automatically regressions if math/defaults changed. No speed claim from raw dump runs or unstable outputs.

After gate passes for a workload, a separate controlled T1 protocol may run with equal effective options. A failed long gate does not invalidate the separate stable short control and does not prove local root cause. Capture source/build/cache/model/template/binary and every loaded library hash, hardware/version/env/commands. One model at a time; scope24G/swap2G,6GiB availability floor,600s timeout,2Hz VRAM/GTT/RAM/clock/power telemetry. ExistingGPU2600/1075MHz,-100mV,186W unchanged. Newmodel SHA recheck before first process.
protocols.TRANSFER-PROTOCOL.md:
# R26 extension: within-B4 short mmap vs none T0/T1

Preregistered after the four B4 repeatability captures, before any B4 none capture or speed process. Cross-version B1/B4 short outputs differ29/129vectors, so no correctness-equivalent cross-version speed ranking. Instead isolate existing load-mode at the same B4 engine/helper/library freeze. Canonical short B4 SHA1c80dca21c7768d9fa61f49d72e452e5c1277137386b08107cdfb54404aa991e, finite/nonzero129vectors. Two fresh NONE correctness captures, one warmup+one raw rep; require exact canonical equality on every value and every-call hash. If gate fails, do not run timing stage. No tolerance adjustment.

Conditional T1: short244+128,c1024; same ncmoe18/ngl99/t8/tb8/b512/ub512/FAon/Q8KV/fitOFF. Eight fresh processes, order mmap/none/none/mmap/mmap/none/none/mmap, four per mode. One internal warmup + three measured repetitions, no profiler/callback/raw dump. Validate all per-call hashes against own B4 canonical and every expected call before accepting timing. All setup/init/defaults recorded, only load-mode varied. No B1/fork timing mixture. Process metrics aggregate token/elapsed separately PP/TG, p95 TG call latency; bootstrap process medians50000 draws with seed20261010. Margins3% PP/TG,5%p95; improvement/regression requires entire CI beyond margin; equivalence requires entire CI inside margin, else inconclusive.

Report warm-file-cache setup ready separately from TTFT, global and client requested/resident VRAM/GTT, MemAvailable/cgroup/RSS with driver host-memory caveat, swap and sampling bounds. Same guardrails and hardware as main protocol. Existing loading mode, no new transfer implementation or cache speedup. HistoricalR22 is external replication context, not pooled sample or cross-version A/B. Raw comparison proves equivalence for this workload, not semantic quality or long none stability.
